integrity.claim_scope: Exact all-N formula plus a uniform asymptotic expansion proved analytically; finite computation is corroborative only.
integrity.external_dependence: The identification of the absolute projection constant with the invariant Walsh-kernel L1 norm uses the published Boolean-cube projection formula.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the second homogeneous Walsh level.
No claim is made that the analogous higher-degree Krawtchouk kernels have the same one-boundary reduction.
An equivalent finite-size identity could conceivably occur in older probability or Krawtchouk literature under different terminology.
title: A lattice-phase second term for second-chaos projection constants on the Boolean cube
